name: FLOT (Fluorouracil / Leucovorin / OXALIplatin / DOCEtaxel), perioperative

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The cytotoxic FLOT backbone (fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, docetaxel) is not biomarker-restricted. HER2, MMR or MSI, and PD-L1 CPS are tested to guide the addition of, or alternative use of, targeted or checkpoint therapy per the guideline; they do not gate the FLOT backbone itself. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gastric Cancer v3.2026, Principles of Biomarker Testing and Perioperative Systemic Therapy.

stage: resectable (cT2 or higher, or node-positive), localized

premedications.name: DOCEtaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid premedication per docetaxel labeling; confirm schedule against institutional order set.

supportiveCare: Cycle structure: 4 preoperative cycles then surgery then 4 postoperative cycles = 8 cycles total, every 2 weeks (DeVita 12th ed., line 96616).
DPYD: consider DPYD genotype or phenotype testing before fluoropyrimidine; reduce or avoid on deficiency.
G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support: docetaxel-containing triplet carries febrile-neutropenia risk; assess per NCCN growth factor guidance.
Antiemetics: oxaliplatin plus docetaxel; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
monitoring: peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle (OXALIplatin)

doseModificationRules.text: Reduce or hold OXALIplatin per neuropathy grade; obtain clinical review. Physician decides.

drugs.name: DOCEtaxel
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 96615. DOCEtaxel 50 mg/m2 IV on day 1, every 2 weeks. Tall-man per ISMP.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 96615 (FLOT: docetaxel 50 mg/m2, day 1, once every 2 weeks)

drugs.name: OXALIplatin
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 96615. OXALIplatin 85 mg/m2 IV on day 1, every 2 weeks. Tall-man per ISMP. Assess peripheral neuropathy each cycle.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 96615 (FLOT: oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2, day 1, once every 2 weeks)

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 96615. Leucovorin 200 mg/m2 IV on day 1, every 2 weeks.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 96615 (FLOT: leucovorin 200 mg/m2, day 1, once every 2 weeks)

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (continuous infusion)
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 96615. Fluorouracil 2600 mg/m2 IV as a 24 hr continuous infusion on day 1, every 2 weeks. DPYD deficiency raises fluoropyrimidine toxicity risk; consider DPYD testing before first dose.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 96614 to 96616 (FLOT: 24 hour infusion of 5-FU 2600 mg/m2, day 1, once every 2 weeks)
